title: Models Policy
description: policies/models.yaml — capability-tier abstraction and harness profile bindings (DESIGN.md §5, spec §7.1, §7.3, §12.4). The platform speaks tiers, never vendor models; profiles are illustrative, editable, dated mappings from tiers to example models per harness. Owner: repo maintainer role; staleness trigger: as_of older than 90 days ⇒ treat as hint (spec §12.4, DESIGN.md §5).

active_profile.description: The profile currently in effect (DESIGN.md §5). Default: generic.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 UTC date the model catalog mappings were last verified (spec §12.4).

owner.description: Owning role, not a person (spec §12.4). Repo maintainer role for this artifact.

profile.description: Maps each capability tier to a description (generic profile) or an example model binding (harness profiles). Values are free-form strings so a harness profile can name an actual model while the generic profile stays vendor-neutral (DESIGN.md §5).
